inputs.text: They’re already turning the “No Kings” rally into a pretext: officers used tear gas and made arrests, then the blame gets shifted to “agitators” so the crackdown can be sold as inevitable. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and elsewhere, but that unfinished account feels deliberate—it keeps people arguing about disorder instead of asking who benefits when dissent is discredited and federal force is normalized. This looks less like neutral reporting than a coordinated effort to shape the story.
